notes: Yamamoto-first discovery pass under the current durable editorial rubric. docs/PRIORITIES.md, docs/EDITORIAL.md, docs/DOMAINS.md, and radar/inbox/README.md were read before grading. ALFIE, BODY&SOUL, Space M&A, Yamamoto schedule sources, and current Japanese jazz sources produced no new unrecorded Tsuyoshi Yamamoto performance. Joshua Bell Leads Beethoven clears RADAR admission because Bell is both solo violinist and conductor in a Beethoven bicentennial program centered on the Violin Concerto and Seventh Symphony. The grade is A+, not S: the 200th-anniversary context and Bell's dual instrumental/conducting role merit active prioritization, while the same program is performed four times across New Jersey, including two Newark dates, so the scarcity required for S is not present.

events.factual_description: NJPAC presents New Jersey Symphony: Joshua Bell Leads Beethoven at Prudential Hall in Newark on Saturday, March 13, 2027 at 7:30 PM and Sunday, March 14, 2027 at 2:00 PM. Bell conducts and performs as violin soloist in a program marking the 200th anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven's death: the Coriolan Overture, Violin Concerto and Symphony No. 7. New Jersey Symphony confirms that the same program also appears in New Brunswick on March 11 and Princeton on March 12 before the two Newark performances.

en.why_it_matters: The specific reason to care is Bell doing both jobs at once: shaping the orchestra from the podium while taking the violin part in Beethoven's only violin concerto, then turning to the Seventh Symphony in a program explicitly built around the bicentennial of Beethoven's death. That puts instrumental identity, interpretation and historical context in the same frame rather than treating the anniversary as decoration.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one of the Newark performances if a New York/New Jersey trip lines up with March 13-14, especially if the classical thread is following major living instrumentalists rather than repertoire alone. The New Brunswick and Princeton performances earlier that week provide enough flexibility that this should complement, not displace, a genuinely scarce one-off elsewhere in the corridor.

es.why_it_matters: La razón concreta para ponerlo en el RADAR es ver a Bell haciendo las dos cosas a la vez: moldear a la orquesta desde la dirección y asumir la parte solista en el único concierto para violín de Beethoven, antes de pasar a la Séptima Sinfonía dentro de un programa armado explícitamente por los 200 años de la muerte del compositor. Así, identidad instrumental, interpretación y contexto histórico quedan dentro del mismo marco en vez de usar el aniversario como simple decoración.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a una de las dos funciones de Newark si un viaje por Nueva York/Nueva Jersey coincide con el 13 o 14 de marzo, sobre todo si el hilo clásico viene siguiendo grandes instrumentistas vivos y no sólo repertorio. Las funciones previas en New Brunswick y Princeton dan suficiente flexibilidad para que esta fecha complemente, y no desplace, a un one-off realmente escaso en otro punto del corredor.
